name: HGS (India)
summary: HGS (India), incorporated in 1986, makes geophones, seismic cables, connectors, seismographs and other geophysical instruments at a single plant in Manesar, Haryana, mainly for oil and gas and mineral exploration, and sells to 146 clients in 21 countries. Revenue fell about 8% in FY26 to ₹45.2 cr after rising from ₹35.5 cr in FY24 to ₹49.1 cr in FY25, while profit rose 10.8% to ₹11.6 cr and the net margin widened to 25.8%. The company has no borrowings, about 69% of the ₹27.9 cr fresh issue goes to plant and machinery replacement and Manesar facility works, and the top 10 customers made up 72.6% of FY26 revenue. At the upper band the post-issue P/E is about 11.2x and price to book about 1.1x; the RHP names no listed peers.

checks.name: Revenue growth
checks.finding: Revenue rose from ₹35.48 cr (FY24) to ₹45.16 cr (FY26), a CAGR of about 12.8%.

checks.name: Revenue rose every year
checks.finding: Revenue fell in the latest year, from ₹49.08 cr in FY25 to ₹45.16 cr in FY26.

checks.name: Debt to equity
checks.finding: Total borrowings were nil at FY26 and at April 30, 2026, so debt to equity is nil.

checks.name: Debt growing slower than revenue
checks.finding: Borrowings were nil in FY24 and FY26 (negligible in FY25), so debt did not grow while revenue rose about 27%.

checks.name: Net worth rising
checks.finding: Net worth fell from ₹95.04 cr (FY24) to ₹85.16 cr (FY25) before rising to ₹89.27 cr (FY26).

checks.name: Positive operating cash flow
checks.finding: Operating cash flow was ₹6.14 cr in FY26, about 53% of the ₹11.64 cr profit.

checks.name: Profit growth
checks.finding: Profit after tax grew 10.8% in FY26, from ₹10.51 cr to ₹11.64 cr.

checks.name: Profit margin trend
checks.finding: PAT margin improved from 11.27% (FY24) to 21.40% (FY25) and 25.77% (FY26).

checks.name: Return on equity
checks.finding: Return on net worth was 13.04% in FY26.

checks.name: Return on capital employed
checks.finding: ROCE was 17.13% in FY26, up from 16.06% in FY25.

checks.name: Margin vs listed peers
checks.finding: The RHP says there are no listed Indian peers, so no peer margin comparison is possible.

checks.name: P/E vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue P/E is about 11.2x, but the RHP names no listed peers to compare against.

checks.name: Price to book vs listed peers
checks.finding: Post-issue price to book is about 1.1x, but there are no listed peers to compare against.

checks.name: Market cap to sales vs listed peers
checks.finding: No listed peers, so market cap to sales cannot be compared.

checks.name: Recent pre-IPO share price
checks.finding: Details of share issues or transfers in the 12 months before the IPO were not found in public sources.

checks.name: Promoter holding after the issue
checks.finding: Promoters hold 63.50% after the issue, down from 87.30%.

checks.name: No pledged promoter shares
checks.finding: None of the promoter or promoter-group shares were pledged as of the RHP date.

checks.name: Related-party transactions
checks.finding: FY26 related-party payments were small (about ₹1.3 cr, mostly director pay), but the company lent ₹9.5 cr to promoter Sowar Pvt Ltd in FY24, repaid by FY25.

checks.name: No regulatory action against promoters
checks.finding: Six direct-tax claims totalling ₹13.09 lakh are pending against promoters and directors.

checks.name: Offer for sale share of the issue
checks.finding: The ₹6.65 cr offer for sale is 19.2% of the ₹34.56 cr issue.

checks.name: Free float after listing
checks.finding: The ₹34.56 cr issue is about 26.5% of the ₹130.3 cr post-issue market cap (1,08,58,713 shares at ₹120).

checks.name: Selling shareholders' cost
checks.finding: The acquisition cost of the 12 selling shareholders was not found in public sources.

checks.name: Money for growth
checks.finding: ₹19.36 cr (69.4% of the fresh issue) goes to plant and machinery replacement, a gold-plating facility and Manesar facility works.

checks.name: Debt repayment share
checks.finding: None of the fresh issue is used to repay debt.

checks.name: General corporate purposes
checks.finding: ₹8.55 cr (30.6% of the fresh issue) goes to unidentified acquisitions and general corporate purposes combined; GCP alone is capped at 15%.

checks.name: No repayment to promoter entities
checks.finding: The objects include no repayment of loans to promoters or group companies.

checks.name: Litigation against the company
checks.finding: Quantified claims against the company total about ₹21 lakh (civil ₹15.28 lakh, tax ₹6.04 lakh), well under 1% of the ₹89.27 cr net worth.

checks.name: Criminal or regulatory cases
checks.finding: Case-level figures for criminal or regulatory proceedings were not found in public sources.

checks.name: Contingent liabilities
checks.finding: A contingent liabilities figure was not found in public sources.

checks.name: Customer concentration
checks.finding: The top 10 customers made up 72.58% of FY26 revenue, and the largest made up 21.79%.

checks.name: Supplier dependence
checks.finding: Imports were 73.65% of FY26 purchases, but supplier-wise shares were not found.

checks.name: Operating history
checks.finding: Incorporated in 1986, so about 40 years of operating history.

checks.name: Auditor remarks
checks.finding: Auditor remarks were not found in public sources.
